items.title: Will Le Pen rise again? French nationalist leader defiant after court's ruling
items.description: Within hours of a court of appeal confirming a guilty verdict, Marine Le Pen had already launched her presidential campaign.

items.title: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
items.description: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the programme in Ankara.

items.title: Russian fuel shortages bite – but will Putin change tack in Ukraine war?
items.description: Even in Moscow, authorities are unable to guarantee fuel supplies, but will economic pressure lead to talks or escalation?

items.title: 'The water just came so fast': Typhoon triggers floods and rare tornadoes in China
items.description: Villagers whose families have been stranded told the BBC they are struggling to get food and help.

items.title: Suspect ate Chick-fil-A and interacted with Charlie Kirk staff before shooting, court hears
items.description: The preliminary hearing will determine whether Tyler Robinson, accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, will stand trial.

items.title: Trains and emergency calls affected after major outage at Australia's largest telecoms company
items.description: Servers at data centres in Sydney and Melbourne were to blame but the exact cause remains unknown.

items.title: Utah boarding school where Paris Hilton alleged abuse as a teen loses its licence
items.description: Hilton said the facility "failed the children", as regulators cited neglect and use of unnecessary restraints.

items.title: Australia dock workers call for 28-hour week in AI talks
items.description: A union says workers are "in the crosshairs" of automation as AI is being tested across ports.

items.title: Top Democrats press Maine Senate candidate to drop out of race over sexual assault allegation
items.description: Graham Platner denied the allegation, calling it "categorically false" but said he was "taking the time to reflect on the best path forward".

items.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
items.description: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.

items.title: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
items.description: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.

items.title: Ghana halts visit by South African president amid row over anti-migrant protests
items.description: Many in Ghana feared his presence would lead to mass protests, and officials say it is postponed for now.
